name: Section divider
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose Section divider.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.label: Variant
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for variant. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Label
settings.how: Enter the label. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Subtitle (chapter only)
settings.how: Use the rich text editor for paragraphs, lists, emphasis, and links. Use descriptive link text and headings in a logical order.

settings.label: Anchor ID
settings.info: Optional unique page anchor. Blank or section-divider uses this section’s unique ID. Use a different custom value for each divider.
settings.how: Enter the anchor id. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Show icon
settings.how: Turn on “Show icon” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Icon name
settings.info: Lucide icon name, for example sparkle, star or check. Uses the theme’s existing icon sprite.
settings.how: Enter the icon name. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.
